words: Tested recipes that scale to your table, switch to cups if you need them, and walk you through every step with timers.
Empty — add a recipe's ingredients above.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water until just tender.
Meanwhile, gently fry sliced garlic in the olive oil until golden.
Toss the pasta with the garlic, lemon zest and juice, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
Season, add black pepper and serve straight away.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss chickpeas, onion and tomatoes with curry paste on a tray.
Roast until the chickpeas crisp at the edges.
Stir in coconut milk and spinach, roast a little more.
Serve with rice or warm flatbreads.
Brown the butter in a pan until it smells nutty. Let it cool.
Mash bananas, whisk in butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour and baking soda. Pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 175°C until a skewer comes out clean.
Stir in the rice for a minute, then the tomatoes.
Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until creamy.
Beat in parmesan and rest for two minutes.
Fry the rice in oil without stirring until crisp underneath.
Chop cucumber, whisk soy, sesame oil and lime.
Toss everything and top with peanuts.
Soften chopped onion and carrots with cumin.
Add lentils and stock, simmer until the lentils collapse.
Blend half, squeeze in lemon and season.
